dataset: World 3 Bahasa Inggris Wajib Chapter 2 - Misi 16 (Hortatory Exposition)
purpose: Bank soal fondasi (Layer 1) untuk teks Eksposisi Hortatori (World 3).

questions.question:
Read the concluding paragraph:
'Based on the rising cases of cyberbullying and online harassment, it is crucial that schools implement strict Netiquette guidelines. Therefore, we should all start practicing empathy before typing a comment on social media.'
What is the generic structure of this paragraph in a Hortatory Exposition text?
questions.explanation: A Hortatory Exposition text always ends with a 'Recommendation', which tells the reader what should or should not be done based on the given arguments. Words like 'it is crucial that...' and 'we should all start...' clearly indicate a recommendation.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal pemahaman struktur akhir teks eksposisi hortatori (Kurikulum Merdeka).
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris

questions.question:
'Cyberbullying is an aggressive behavior. It happens repeatedly online. It has severe psychological impacts.'
Combine the three sentences into one cohesive sentence using appropriate relative pronouns and conjunctions.
options: Cyberbullying is an aggressive behavior which happens repeatedly online and has severe psychological impacts.
Cyberbullying is an aggressive behavior who happens repeatedly online so it has severe psychological impacts.
Because cyberbullying is an aggressive behavior it happens repeatedly online but has severe psychological impacts.
Although cyberbullying happens repeatedly online, it is an aggressive behavior which has severe psychological impacts.
questions.answer: Cyberbullying is an aggressive behavior which happens repeatedly online and has severe psychological impacts.
questions.explanation: The relative pronoun 'which' accurately replaces 'It' to refer to 'aggressive behavior' (a non-human noun). The conjunction 'and' logically connects the ongoing action with its impacts without altering the original meaning.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal drill grammar (K13) untuk menguji kemampuan sintaksis dalam menyusun kalimat majemuk bertingkat (Complex Sentences).
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris

questions.question:
Read the statement from a debate on Netiquette:
'Regulating Netiquette is fundamentally useless. Trolls will always exist, and anonymity empowers them to bypass any artificial rules set by forum moderators.'
Which of the following counter-arguments most effectively weakens the statement above?
options: Trolls are mostly teenagers who will eventually outgrow their bad behavior.
Anonymity is a human right, so we must accept that trolling is part of free speech.
Platforms that enforce strict identity verification and community guidelines have seen a 70% drop in harassment cases.
Moderators should just ban all anonymous users to solve the problem permanently.
questions.answer: Platforms that enforce strict identity verification and community guidelines have seen a 70% drop in harassment cases.
questions.explanation: The original statement claims that rules are 'useless' because anonymity empowers trolls to bypass them. The counter-argument directly attacks this premise by providing statistical evidence that enforcing rules (community guidelines) and removing anonymity (identity verification) practically reduces harassment, thus proving the rules are NOT useless.
questions.provenance: Soal orisinal literasi logika analitis (TKA Bonus) yang menuntut siswa mengevaluasi 'kekuatan argumen' dan mematahkan premis lawan secara berbasis data.
questions.subject: Bahasa Inggris
